messages:
acme_secops: Hi Redwood — for our SIG/CAIQ review we need artifacts showing how you enforce SSO (SAML/ADFS), SCIM provisioning, RBAC/least-privilege, and MFA enforcement. Also need a sample role matrix and where to find audit logs. Targeting POC next week, can you provide by EOD tomorrow?

ana (acct exec): @kevin @sarah tagging you both — ACME needs a concise evidence bundle (SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, role matrix, MFA enforcement proof). They specifically asked for scoped provisioning examples and a short note on how to enforce conditional access.

kevin (solutions engineer): We can put together a compressed evidence bundle. What they usually accept: 1) SAML metadata + IdP config screenshot 2) SCIM provisioning attributes & example PATCH/POST logs 3) RBAC role matrix (CSV) 4) MFA enforcement policy doc and sample login audit. I can assemble the files and upload to a shared folder.

kevin (solutions engineer): Quick SCIM mapping example (sendable):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "add",
    "path": "emails",
    "value": [{"value": "user@acme.com", "type": "work"}]
  }]
}
```

sarah (security eng): For MFA and conditional access evidence: we can provide the console screenshot of the policy (enforced for all org logins), a sample tenant conditional access rule (time-based + device compliance), and exports from our audit stream showing enforcement events. Do they need raw syslog exports or just exported CSV samples?

acme_secops: CSV samples are fine for initial review. Full logs may be requested later. Also need a short explanation of how least-privilege roles are scoped for the POC environment.

mike (platform eng): For POC we recommend three scoped roles: 1) read-only-viewer (can query endpoints, no write), 2) deployment-operator (can create/scale deployments in a single namespace), 3) admin-ops (full within POC boundary). Keep service accounts per-integration and restrict token lifetime to 1h for POC. Example RBAC matrix (rows = role, cols = resource/actions) will be in the CSV.

kevin (solutions engineer): SAML metadata snippet we usually provide to customers to import into their IdP:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.dev/saml">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.dev/_saml/consume"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

kevin (solutions engineer): Also attaching our SCIM attribute list (username, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work], groups) and a sample provisioning log line showing a 201 created for a user. Uploading artifacts to shared drive now.

deploy-bot: uploaded rbac-role-matrix-poc.csv to https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/redwood-evidence/ACME/poc-1856

ana (acct exec): For timeline — I'll aim to deliver the bundle by EOD tomorrow. @kevin can you include a 1-page summary that explains the least-privilege decisions and the MFA enforcement policy? ACME also asked about whether dedicated capacity or hosted API changes anything for access controls.

kevin (solutions engineer): Dedicated vs hosted: controls are the same for SSO and SCIM. Differences: Dedicated gives customer network isolation + ability to push custom SAML tweaks; for RBAC we support the same role model but you can add network-level IP restrictions in Dedicated. Pricing impact for a short POC is minimal if they use shared hosted credits; if they want reserved capacity we should surface a short quote — I'll follow up with pricing.

acme_secops: Thanks. Can you also confirm SLA for audit log retention we send in the bundle and how quickly MFA policy changes propagate?

sarah (security eng): Audit exports: we can provide 90-day CSV samples for review; production retention is configurable per enterprise contract (90/365/730 days options). MFA policy changes propagate within ~30s to 2m (policy push + cache invalidation); I'll capture a sample enforcement event (timestamped) in the bundle.

ana (acct exec): Great. Plan: kevin + sarah assemble artifacts (SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, role matrix CSV, MFA policy screenshot, 3 sample audit CSV rows), I will upload and send to ACME and schedule a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow morning. Will update thread when uploaded. :rocket:

acme_secops: Sounds good, appreciate the quick response.
